'''Rybese''' was the native language of the [[Rybet/Legends|Rybet]] species that could come from [[Varl/Legends|Varl]]. Rybese was a language that featured grunts and croaks.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />

Most Rybets were fluent in both Rybese and [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], although they were only literate in their own language.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />
